headline: U.S.-Israel Strikes Target Iranian Military Infrastructure Amid Regional Escalation
subheadline: U.S. Central Command completes 13th night of strikes against Iranian military sites, including drone storage and communication networks.
lede: U.S. and Israeli forces conducted strikes against Iranian military sites, including drone storage and communication networks, while Iran and Houthi rebels launched attacks on regional targets. Iranian missiles struck a U.S. base in Al-Salti, with most intercepted by American defenses. Meanwhile, Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked Saudi Arabia's Al-Salamah base in Kuwait, prompting Kuwaiti air defenses to intercept missiles.

sections.title: Russian Advances in Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia
sections.body: Russian forces liberated Artelovo in Kharkiv direction and Blahodatne in Zaporizhzhia, with ongoing combat in Kupyansk, Dobropillia, and Kherson sectors. Russian troops used the 34th Guards Motor Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion to capture Artelovo. Ukrainian reserves increased in western Kupyansk. Ukrainian strikes hit Russian border regions, including Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk, and Leningrad Oblast, with 50 UAVs downed in Leningrad.

sections.title: Iranian and Houthi Attacks on Regional Targets
sections.body: Iranian missiles struck a U.S. base in Al-Salti, with most intercepted by American defenses. Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked Saudi Arabia's Al-Salamah base in Kuwait, prompting Kuwaiti air defenses to intercept missiles. Iranian drones and missiles targeted Israeli settlements in Shomron and Manasseh, prompting IDF operations. U.S. and Saudi Arabia negotiated a civilian nuclear deal contingent on Saudi joining the Iran nuclear agreement.

sections.title: Regional Tensions and Escalation Risks
sections.body: U.S. and Israeli operations targeting Iranian military capabilities and proxy groups like the Houthis highlight ongoing regional instability. The lack of de-escalation efforts suggests a high risk of further escalation. Ukraine's new mobilization mechanism and Russian advances in Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia indicate both sides preparing for winter, with Russia's rising oil revenues sustaining war funding.
